description: Visualizes and represents numbers up to 1,000 with emphasis on numbers 101 to 1,000 and gives the place value of a digit.
Adds 2- to 3-digit numbers with sums up to 1,000, with and without regrouping.
Subtracts 2- to 3-digit numbers with and without regrouping.
Visualizes and illustrates multiplication of numbers 1 to 10 through repeated addition and arrays.
Solves routine and non-routine problems involving multiplication.
Visualizes and illustrates division as equal sharing and repeated subtraction, and relates it to multiplication.
Visualizes, represents and compares unit fractions and similar fractions (1/2, 1/3, 1/4, ...).
Tells time in minutes, including a.m. and p.m.
Finds the perimeter of squares, rectangles and other plane figures, and measures length in meters and centimeters.
